0022600198.text: The Timberwolves host the Utah Jazz in their 11th game of the season, with Minnesota at 7-3 after a three-game winning streak, second in the Northwest and fifth in the West, while Utah is 1-8 on a seven-game losing streak and fifth in the Northwest. Anthony Edwards (knee, surgery) and Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles, surgery) are out for Minnesota, and Utah has Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee) and Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain) out, with Keyonte George (illness) and Lauri Markkanen (wrist sprain) listed as day-to-day game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Timberwolves won the 2025-26 series 3-1, including a 147-111 victory over Utah in Minneapolis on March 18, 2026.
